description: PROTOTYPE (QA #42, A5). Qwen Code (>=0.24) hooks for the Crosstalk bus. Merge the `hooks` object into ~/.qwen/settings.json on an ENROLLED machine and replace <plugin-src> with the installed plugin's src dir. Same protocol as Claude Code hooks: stdin JSON with session_id, exit 2 blocks. `timeout` is in SECONDS. User-level hooks need no trust prompt but are read only at session start. The receive bridge needs the session to run under `qwen serve` (QWEN_SERVE_URL, default http://127.0.0.1:4170). SECURITY: bus text reaches an agent that can run tools — pin an explicit tool allowlist in the same settings.json (no "*" in permissions.allow) before enabling this on a real profile.
